main_text.l: 8. Legati aures sint atq; oculi regnorum.
9. Constantia & παῤῥησία, pii legatorum candoris erga suum Principem & patriam index.
Quae sit illicita & aculeata, & quae licita παρ-ρησία.
Cur legatis interdictum sit lege, accipere munera? Quia
Qualia à legato accipienda sint munera?
11. Legatus spectata esto fidei & verax: nec mandatorum suorum fines perfidè transiliat.
Παραβρησεία[?]: cujus poena justa itemque noxa additur, ubi tamen & illud no-tandum,
Quando legato libera agendi dari foleat fa-cultas?

page.notes: The Greek words "παῤῥησία", "ἀξιόσοι", "Ἀσωφαγία" and "Παραβρησεία" are read from a small, faded print and may be wrong; the marked ones are doubtful. The "?" after "perorando" may be a printed mark rather than a letter. Stains and show-through from the reverse side were left out.
